LESSON: READING ALOUD: GRADE APPROPRIATE TEXTS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.5 Guided Reading: Picture Reading (2 sessions) • Picture events • Oral
Topic 2.7: Reading Aloud: Grade Appropriate Texts
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud: Grade Appropriate Texts, part of Reading 2.5 Guided Reading: Picture Reading (2 sessions) • Picture events • Oral in Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why is reading important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work with peers to conduct a reader’s theatre to read simple texts about the parts of body fluently,

2. identify vocabulary from the text from familiar and unfamiliar words,

3. collaborate with peers to build a vocabulary bank of words related to the theme,

4. infer meaning of unfamiliar words from the texts based on context,

5. collaborate with peers to look up the meaning of unfamiliar words in the dictionary or reference materials.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work with peers to conduct a reader’s theatre to read simple texts about the parts of body fluently,
2. identify vocabulary from the text from familiar and unfamiliar words,
3. collaborate with peers to build a vocabulary bank of words related to the theme,
4. infer meaning of unfamiliar words from the texts based on context,
5. collaborate with peers to look up the meaning of unfamiliar words in the dictionary or reference materials.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud: Grade Appropriate Texts together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: This is developed as the learner considered possible perspectives and views to infer

meaning of unfamiliar words from the texts based on context.

• Communication and collaboration: This is enhanced as the learner engages actively with peers to conduct a reader’s theatre

to read simple texts about the parts of body fluently.

Values:
Responsibility: This is promoted as the learner takes up assigned roles in teams when building a vocabulary bank of words

related to the theme.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: This is promoted as the learner appreciates the role that others play in achievement of group goals when taking

part in group tasks.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to link this concept on parts of the body to similar concepts as is covered in Science and Technology.
